title: Idea agent (no tools)
description: Returns 4 short meal ideas. Prompt: prompts/idea.md. Macros here are rough guesses for the idea cards only, never used for the result page.

kitchen_profile.description: Profile text, rendered from prompts/kitchen-profile.default.json or the user's own profile.

inspiration.description: Real dishes picked by smartbite_engine.inspiration for this request.

main_ingredients.description: The idea's main foods in English, names from known_ingredients when listed, no pantry items. The recipe must keep each one.

image_prompt.description: Short food photo description, copied by the user into an image tool.

changes.description: The user's own edits from the idea preview, set by code after a revision. The recipe follows them.
